name: How long does a kitchen plumbing upgrade take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen plumbing upgrade take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen plumbing upgrade depends on its complexity. A simple faucet or garbage disposal installation might take a few hours. More involved projects, such as rerouting pipes, installing a new sink, or a full kitchen plumbing renovation, can take several days to a week, especially if it involves opening walls or coordinating with other trades like cabinet installers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrade times vary; a simple installation can be hours, while complex projects like rerouting pipes or full renovations may take several days to a week.
